title: Insider data theft: after-hours bulk export by a privileged DBA

anomaly.summary: Anomaly trigger: large outbound upload to an unsanctioned personal cloud endpoint from a DBA workstation
anomaly.spl: index=network sourcetype=pan:traffic dest_ip=198.51.100.44 | where bytes_out > 1000000 | stats sum(bytes_out) as out_bytes by src_host

decoy_hypothesis.statement: H1: The biggest data mover is account {bf_ip} ({bf_count} rows exported) — that nightly job is the data-theft culprit.
decoy_hypothesis.seed_spl: index=dlp sourcetype=db:audit event=bulk_export | stats sum(record_count) as count by user | rename user as src_ip | sort -count

refutation.success_check_spl: index=dlp sourcetype=db:audit event=bulk_export user={bf_ip} business_hours=false approved=false
refutation.no_success_reason: the high-volume account {bf_ip} only ran approved exports during business hours (no after-hours, unapproved export)

corrected_hypothesis.statement: H2: The real data theft is privileged DBA j.kwon exporting customers, payment_methods and salaries after hours (unapproved) from a BYOD device, then uploading ~30MB to an unsanctioned personal cloud endpoint — NOT the approved nightly ETL job, despite its larger row count.
corroborating_spl: index=dlp sourcetype=db:audit event=bulk_export business_hours=false approved=false | stats sum(record_count) as records values(table_name) as tables by user
index=network sourcetype=pan:traffic dest_ip=198.51.100.44 | stats sum(bytes_out) as out by src_host
corrected_hypothesis.rationale: SPL shows j.kwon's after-hours, unapproved exports of sensitive tables followed by an upload to a non-approved data processor — a corroborated insider-exfiltration chain that volume-alone ranking would have missed.

root_cause: A privileged DBA (j.kwon) abused legitimate database access to run after-hours, unapproved bulk exports of customers, payment_methods, and salaries from a personal BYOD device, then uploaded the data to an unsanctioned personal cloud-storage endpoint.

host_queries: index=dlp sourcetype=db:audit event=bulk_export business_hours=false approved=false | stats count by host
blast_radius.identity_query: index=dlp sourcetype=db:audit event=bulk_export business_hours=false approved=false | dedup user | table user

remediation: Suspend j.kwon's database and SSO access pending investigation; preserve the db:audit trail.
Block egress to the unsanctioned endpoint 198.51.100.44 and revoke the DBA workstation's session.
Engage HR and legal; scope exactly which customer / payment / salary records left.
Require approval + just-in-time access for bulk exports of sensitive tables.
Add a DLP correlation search for (after-hours bulk export AND unapproved AND egress to non-approved processor).
Disallow BYOD devices from privileged database access.
